peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 4.9% below its local comparables; 57 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (58.7): 3.4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 229 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 3). Context, not scored: resales in 79.2% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $1,300,000 ($2,157 psf, 602 sq ft; 5 resales, Aug 2025–Jul 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,327 psf (range $1,995–2,718); 7.3% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $102,000 less. 2-bedroom: median $2,257,500 ($2,412 psf, 796–947 sq ft; 6 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,475 psf (range $1,968–3,072); 2.5% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $59,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Cantonment MRT about 190 m, Outram Park MRT about 460 m; closer than 578 of 662 similar developments (the same as 7). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 1 within 2 km; nearest Zhangde Primary School about 1,570 m; more than 0 of 662 similar developments (the same as 125). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 700 m), more than 243 of 662 similar developments (the same as 37); nearest hawker centre Blk 6 Tanjong Pagar Plaza Market And Food Centre about 720 m; nearest park Rail Corridor about 580 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Blk 6 Tanjong Pagar Plaza Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Newport Residences, 203 new sales, about 800 m; TMW Maxwell, 1 new sales, about 980 m; Skywaters Residences, 5 new sales, about 1,160 m; W Residences Marina View - Singapore, 14 new sales, about 1,450 m; Union Square Residences, 106 new sales, about 1,590 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 1,740 m; Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 1,860 m; The Robertson Opus, 40 new sales, about 1,910 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 77 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,105 new sales and 485 resales (1,590 purchases); new sales were 69.5% of these purchases. Subsales (31) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 485 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 105 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 485 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 564 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−14%). Planning-area private resales −18%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
